questions.question: What did Zechariah see in the vision of chapter 4?
options: Four war chariots passing between two bronze mountains
A golden lampstand with two olive trees beside it
A woman seated in a basket of lead
A flying scroll covered with writing
questions.answer: A golden lampstand with two olive trees beside it

questions.question: What famous word came to Zerubbabel in Zechariah 4?
options: 'A great and mighty army will defend the whole holy city'
'By the strength of your own two hands the work is fully done'
'Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit, says the LORD'
'The gathered wealth of all the nations will build my house'
questions.answer: 'Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit, says the LORD'

questions.question: Zechariah 4 says whoever has despised the day of small things will rejoice to see the plumb line in Zerubbabel's hand.
Not by might, nor by power, but by my _____, says the LORD of hosts.
The hands of _____ have laid the foundation of this house; his hands shall also complete it.
